title: What will be the furthest round PV Sindhu reaches in individual badminton at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: PV Sindhu is an Indian badminton player and multiple Olympic medallist.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official 2026 Asian Games badminton results or reliable contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution Condition : Once Sindhu's participation in the individual badminton competition has concluded, identify the furthest tournament round she reached. Team competition results do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the tournament round.
